name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx reverse proxy and web server for three SSL-enabled virtual sites, including static content, security settings, Fail2ban, firewall and SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log and PID directories, and compatibility configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI application with Python and PostgreSQL, including the virtual environment, application dependencies, database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
